newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans drop.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans drop.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower on a late break in soybeans, traders said.
Diminished fears about cold-weather-related crop losses led the way down, they said.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 25,000 contracts, down from 31,622 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 30,000 contracts, down from 43,790 Tuesday.
Soyoil futures closed 0.05 to 0.24 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.20 at 23.75 cents. Soymeal was $0.50 to $2.30 per ton lower, with October down $2.10 at $246.80 a ton.
